title: Quintessential Irish Pappardelle Pasta
description: A spicy, cheesy, and satisfying Irish dish featuring pappardelle pasta, perfect for a hangover cure, and can be made gluten-free friendly by substituting the pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced irish sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
Stir in the shredded irish cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
